title: Polymarket: resolution and disputes

sources.sourceRole: Primary publication; account may be retrospective or interested-party

documentedClaim: The venue describes rule-based resolution through the UMA optimistic oracle and dispute handling.
inferredMechanism: Payout timing and contract interpretation can differ from a generic forecast of the real-world event.
counterevidence: Current rules do not establish historical rule versions; publicity-selected disputes are a biased sample.
transferRequirements: Require original question/rule versions, dispute history, settlement timestamps, fees and executable quotes. No oracle participation is authorized.
outcomeBoundary: Public narrative already inspected; described cases are discovery examples, never untouched confirmation. No experimental market outcome dataset opened.
